title: Bauval, Hancock and Schoch on Sphinx weathering and the Orion 10,500 BC alignment

tellings.quote: like Robert Bauval and Graham Hancock and Robert Schoch who since the 90s have been saying very interesting things about, you know, possibly limestone damage on the Sphinx

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, points to three writers, Robert Bauval, Graham Hancock and Robert Schoch, who since the 1990s have argued unusual things about ancient Egypt. He mentions their claims about wear on the limestone of the Sphinx, the great stone statue at Giza, and the story also includes the idea that the pyramids line up with the stars of the constellation Orion as they stood around 10,500 BC. If true, it would mean these monuments are far older than usually thought.
